purpose: Declaration of the Forgejo CI gates, one entry per job of .forgejo/workflows/fgate.yml. The crate graph is not restated here: it lives in infra/crate-topology.json (SSOT). A gate that proves a crate names it in `proves`; crates/cynic-audit-engine/tests/ci_plan_coherence.rs checks that every name exists in the topology and that every job of the workflow is declared here. This file does not change workflow behaviour by itself: no job reads it yet.

capability_labels.cynic/build: Rust build runner (builder or compute-01, observed, not declared)

scope_rules.always: Run for every pull request, whatever the diff.
scope_rules.affected: Run only when the crate named in `proves` is affected by the diff: changed crates plus every crate that depends on them, transitively, per infra/crate-topology.json.
scope_rules.runner_or_infra: Run only when the runner definition or the gate definitions change: .forgejo/** or infra/registry.json. Operator decision 2026-10-26: not required on every pull request.

open_questions: Per-crate test cost is not measured: a test job scales with the reverse-dependency closure (median 6 crates, p90 34 on 249 code commits, topology-based).
Which gates are mandatory for every pull request regardless of scope (see socle decision).
Whether the proof scope must be emitted as a job output so it survives routing to another machine (today it is a local file).
